dct_description_sm:
Mileage markers, also often called kilometer markers, allow road users and safety workers to use road signs to locate on the road network. 

Mileage markers are installed on all motorways and they can also be installed on other classes of roads (e.g. national road) where there are tracking problems or an absence of services.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
